integrity_notes: Symbolic proof plus reproducible standard-library finite-field checker. No independent scientific audit or independent validation. Literature priority is a same-model assessment, not a global uniqueness certificate.
scientific_limitations: Applies to all smooth parameters of \(y^5=x(x-1)(x-\lambda)\) over algebraically closed characteristic-three fields; establishes Cartier iterate ranks, \(a\)-number, and \(3\)-rank, not complete Ekedahl--Oort or Newton-polygon types. Historical equivalence via other parameterizations remains a risk.
title: The unique square-zero Cartier fiber in a characteristic-three cyclic quintic family
